name: warn-usage
description: Warns when context window usage or 5-hour/7-day session usage limits reach a threshold

contextWarnAt.title: Context window usage warning (%)
contextWarnAt.description: Context window usage that raises a warning, from 1 to 100

sessionWarnAt.title: 5-hour session usage limit warning (%)
sessionWarnAt.description: 5-hour session usage limit that raises a warning, from 1 to 100

weekWarnAt.title: 7-day session usage limit warning (%)
weekWarnAt.description: 7-day session usage limit that raises a warning, from 1 to 100

contextToastSeconds.title: Context window usage warning duration (seconds)
contextToastSeconds.description: How long this warning stays on screen, from 4 to 60 seconds

sessionToastSeconds.title: 5-hour session usage limit warning duration (seconds)
sessionToastSeconds.description: How long this warning stays on screen, from 4 to 60 seconds
